headline: HBX Group Posts €9.2B in Full-Year 2026 Total Transaction Value
summary: HBX Group International announced its full-year 2026 financial results, reporting a 14 percent increase in Total Transaction Value to €9.2 billion with double-digit growth across all three operating regions.
why: HBX Group is a major global travel technology and distribution provider reflecting broader travel and tourism booking demand.

impacts.name: HBX Group International plc
impacts.why: Strong double-digit transaction value growth points to robust underlying business expansion.
